name: Watchpost AI
positioning: Watchpost sells safety teams a video platform; Keelstone gives the safety manager, the CFO and the broker one shared risk story that shows up at renewal. When the deal will be decided by the people who pay for workers' comp, not only the people who watch the video, we win.

scorecard.note: Both run on existing IP cameras. Watchpost detects more PPE types out of the box.
We blur at the edge by default; Watchpost blurs in the cloud and only on request.
Our weekly coaching feed is built in; theirs is a clip export.
We draft 300, 300A and 301 entries. Watchpost has none.
Their cloud connector skips the on-site gateway: hours, not a day.

whyWeWin.point: We speak to the CFO and the broker, not just safety
whyWeWin.proof: Total cost of risk dashboard and broker risk report ship in v1; Watchpost has neither.

whyWeWin.point: Privacy that passes the works council and the union
whyWeWin.proof: Edge blurring on by default and a written coaching-not-discipline policy.

whyWeWin.point: We close the OSHA paperwork loop
whyWeWin.proof: OSHA 300/300A/301 drafts with an audit trail.

whereTheyWin: Faster first deployment through their cloud connector
Larger PPE and vehicle detection library
Multilingual alerts and a stronger presence outside the US

objections.theySay: Watchpost is live in an afternoon. Keelstone needs a gateway at every site.
objections.youSay: The gateway is why video never leaves the site unblurred. Ask their IT team which one they would rather defend in a security review.
Ask how many of those alerts turned into a lower premium. Detection is the start; we connect it to claims, OSHA and renewal.
In safety-only deals, yes. Ask the prospect who owns the workers' comp budget, then ask whether Watchpost has ever been in front of that person.

landmines: Where is video blurred: on site or after it reaches the cloud?
How will your broker see the improvement at renewal?
Who drafts your OSHA 300 log today, and how long does it take?
What will the CFO be shown at the six-month review?
messaging: See every hazard on every shift
Live in hours on the cameras you already have
Trusted by safety teams in 30 countries

products.name: Watchpost Platform
products.description: Cloud video analytics for hazards, PPE and vehicles

products.name: Watchpost Connect
products.description: Cloud connector for existing camera systems, no on-site hardware

products.name: Watchpost Ergo
products.description: Lift and posture scoring add-on, launched September 2026

positive.detail: Reviewers keep mentioning going live in a day without new hardware.
Few false positives on PPE and forklift alerts.
Named CSM and quick ticket turnaround.

negative.detail: Supervisors get too many notifications at large sites.
Hard to turn events into something finance or leadership will read.
Some crews see it as surveillance; blurring has to be requested.

positive.detail: Employees like working on injury prevention.

negative.detail: Quota increases after the Series C.

fieldIntel.author: Dana R. (AE, Central)
fieldIntel.text: Watchpost offered a free 90-day pilot at a 6-site food processor to block our evaluation. Prospect's IT lead was uneasy about cloud-side blurring.

fieldIntel.author: Marcus T. (SE)
fieldIntel.text: Watchpost demo showed the new Ergo add-on. Lift scoring looks comparable to ours; no OSHA or broker output.
